extension.summary: StremioELEC Core and optional StremioELEC Skin for Kodi 21
extension.description: Installs StremioELEC Core plus StremioELEC Skin as a normal Kodi skin addon. Existing Kodi installations keep their current interface until the user explicitly selects StremioELEC Skin. OS-level LibreELEC updates are not installed.
